security_audit.summary: This is a prompt-only AWS guidance skill with no executable code, scripts, or command hooks. The two static network findings are source repository URLs in metadata and prose, not runtime network activity. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or business-logic abuse was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL on line 4 is frontmatter source metadata that points to the upstream repository. It does not instruct the assistant to fetch data, send data, or execute any network operation.
The URL on line 22 is a prose link to the source repository for more information. It is not paired with credential handling, automation, or any instruction to make an outbound request.

content.value_statement: AWS work requires clear architecture and deployment choices. This skill guides cloud development, infrastructure automation, and AWS pattern selection.
actual_capabilities: Provides guidance for AWS development tasks.
Helps decide when to apply AWS development guidance.
Points users to the upstream source repository for more detail.
limitations: Contains only prompt guidance, not executable automation.
Does not include service-specific deployment commands.
Does not verify AWS account settings or permissions.
Does not replace current AWS documentation or security review.

use_cases.title: Plan AWS Application Work
use_cases.description: Use the skill to organize AWS development tasks and architecture considerations before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Infrastructure Automation Ideas
use_cases.description: Use the skill to discuss automation patterns for repeatable cloud infrastructure work.

use_cases.title: Prepare Cloud Architecture Notes
use_cases.description: Use the skill to frame AWS architecture guidance for design reviews and team planning.

prompt_templates.title: Describe an AWS Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the aws-skills guidance to help me plan this AWS development task: [describe task].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Architecture Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the aws-skills guidance to compare AWS architecture patterns for [workload] with these constraints: [constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Infrastructure Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the aws-skills guidance to outline infrastructure automation steps for [environment] and identify review points.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Cloud Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the aws-skills guidance to review this AWS cloud design for development workflow, automation fit, and architecture tradeoffs: [design].

output_examples.input: Plan an AWS development workflow for a small service.
output: A short workflow that separates application changes, infrastructure changes, and review checkpoints.
Architecture considerations for deployment, observability, and repeatable environments.

output_examples.input: Review infrastructure automation options for a cloud project.
output: A comparison of automation approaches based on repeatability, team ownership, and operational risk.
A list of questions to resolve before implementation.

best_practices: Provide the AWS workload, constraints, and target environment before asking for guidance.
Ask for architecture tradeoffs when several AWS patterns could fit.
Validate final implementation details against current AWS documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to deploy resources without a separate implementation plan.
Do not treat general AWS guidance as a security approval.
Do not omit account, region, compliance, and operational constraints.

faq.question: Does this skill run AWS commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains guidance text only and does not execute commands.

faq.question: Can it create infrastructure automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can help plan infrastructure automation, but it does not include automation scripts.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it specific to one AWS service?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes AWS development, infrastructure automation, and cloud architecture patterns broadly.

faq.question: Should I verify the guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. Check current AWS documentation and your organization policies before implementation.

faq.question: Why were network findings dismissed?
faq.answer: The flagged URLs are source repository references, not instructions to make network requests.
